data-attr.description: Sets one or more attributes from expressions.

data-bind.description: Two-way binding between an input element and a signal.

data-class.description: Toggles CSS classes from boolean expressions.

data-computed.description: A read-only signal derived from other signals.

data-effect.description: Runs an expression whenever a signal it reads changes.

data-ignore.description: Datastar leaves this element (and its subtree, unless __self) alone.

data-indicator.description: A boolean signal that is true while a fetch from this element is in flight.

data-init.description: Runs an expression once when the element enters the DOM.

data-json-signals.description: Renders the signal store as JSON into the element. Debugging aid.

data-on.description: Attaches an event listener. `evt` is the event; `el` the element.

data-on-intersect.description: Runs an expression when the element intersects the viewport.

data-on-interval.description: Runs an expression on an interval (default 1s).

data-on-signal-patch.description: Runs an expression whenever signals are patched. `patch` holds the patch.

data-on-signal-patch-filter.description: Filters which signal patches trigger data-on-signal-patch.

data-preserve-attr.description: Keeps the listed attributes through a morph.

data-ref.description: Exposes the element as a signal.

data-show.description: Shows the element when the expression is truthy.

data-signals.description: Declares signals. Dotted names create nested signals.

data-text.description: Sets the element's text content from an expression.

data-nonce.description: On the html element: enables CSP mode with this nonce.

data-animate.description: Pro: Pro. Animates an attribute whenever the expression's signals change.

data-custom-validity.description: Pro: Pro. Custom form validation: '' is valid, any other string is the message.

data-match-media.description: Pro: Pro. A boolean signal that follows a media query.

data-on-raf.description: Pro: Pro. Runs on every animation frame.

data-on-resize.description: Pro: Pro. Runs when the element's size changes.

data-persist.description: Pro: Pro. Persists signals in local or session storage.

data-query-string.description: Pro: Pro. Two-way sync between signals and the URL query string.

data-replace-url.description: Pro: Pro. Replaces the browser URL without reloading.

data-scroll-into-view.description: Pro: Pro. Scrolls the element into view.

data-view-transition.description: Pro: Pro. Sets the element's view-transition-name.

data-on:click @post.description: Post signals to the server on click.

data-init @get.description: Open a stream when the element appears.
